methods.what: General formula (end of (18.2)): series expressed via $\Gamma(s)\zeta(s)$ and a sum over coprime pairs $\mu,\nu$
Symmetrisation in $\mu\leftrightarrow\nu$ and the cosine sum formula, giving a factor $2\cos(\pi s/4)$
Evaluation of $\sum \sigma_{s-1}(n)e^{-2\pi n}$ in terms of $\zeta(s)$ and a sum over sums of two coprime squares
Alternating series $\sum (-1)^{n-1}\sigma_{s-1}(n)e^{-\pi n\sqrt3}$ obtained by substituting $x=\tfrac12(\sqrt3+i)$, involving the form $\mu^2+\mu\nu+\nu^2$
